method: Twelve-second full-throttle launches from settled rest on separate level or 1.6-degree banked BoxCollider lanes. Current centered production prefab. First car uses W through Input System; all others request raw zero steering. Acceptance uses actual saved production physics plus normal level0/level3 development, requiring flat drift<1m/heading<1deg, banked drift<5m/heading<2deg, four wheels grounded, speed>170km/h and zero steering. Diagnostic controls recreate original 8500 damping/0.05 force point/old COM and compare a 3500 damping alternative; sampled every 0.2 seconds.
